Origin and meaning

The name Judy has Hebrew roots and means “praised (diminutive of Judith)”.

About the name Judy

A friendly short form of Judith, and the name of the actress Judy Garland.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “praised (diminutive of Judith)”, a Judy calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
